title: Abdali Repents the Punjab Campaign and the Khalsa Triumphs

blocks.text: The episode ends with Abdali's own bitter reckoning. Much did he repent for his expedition, admitting in effect that the power he expected to crush turned out to be the force that harried and humiliated him across Punjab.

His explanation is theological as well as military. He concludes that the almighty God had supported the Singhs, and from now onwards if anyone from my progeny ever entered this region, that descendant should expect regret rather than glory.

The author then seals the reversal in historical terms. On the way to Kabul did he die, and the Khalsa Panth emerges from the episode as Ahmed Shah's destroyer in reputation, the community that shattered the certainty of the invader who had once terrorized the north.
